title: No-Show Deduction from Freeze Days on a Self-Pay Visit Package
content:
**Attendance policy extract.** On unfreezing a Self-Pay Visit Package, the no-show deduction counts the no-shows recorded on package-funded appointments — no-show entries in the patient's Appointment Series history funded by the self-pay package: **7 days** for two or more, **3 days** for exactly one, and none for none. The deduction is subtracted from the freeze-credit days after the freeze days have been capped, and the freeze-credit days never go below zero.

| No-shows on package-funded appointments | Deduction |
|---|---|
| 0 | none |
| 1 | 3 days |
| 2 or more | 7 days |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical)**

- Freeze-credit days of 20 before the deduction, one no-show: 20 less 3 is 17 days.
- Freeze-credit days of 20 before the deduction, two no-shows: 20 less 7 is 13 days.
- Freeze-credit days of 5 before the deduction, two no-shows: 5 less 7 would fall below zero, so the freeze-credit days are 0 and the expiry date does not move.
- Late cancellations are not no-shows and are not counted here.
